dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Both repeatable flags and help are present, but the command accepts the two selection forms together and permits formatted export with selections.
evidence: product.diff: registers StringArray --field and --field-id plus a repeated-field example
product.diff: selectedFields appends names and IDs without an exclusivity check; runList resolves fields before exporter.Write
product.diff: TestNewCmdList explicitly parses both flag forms together

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical names, and actionable unknown-field errors are implemented. Ambiguity is detected, but matching IDs are returned in source order without explicit deterministic sorting.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold and returns the canonical ProjectField
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: unknown name/ID errors build sorted candidate lists
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous-match IDs are appended without sorting

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The initial item query's field definitions are reused and lookup failures return before rendering. However, selected fields beyond the initial 100-definition page are never fetched.
evidence: product.diff: runList resolves from project.Fields.Nodes without a preflight lookup
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems requests firstFields = LimitMax and paginates only ProjectItem nodes
product.diff: contains no field-pagination call or PageInfo handling

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value types are rendered, with empty output for absent IDs and unknown types. The supplied path does not establish carriage-return/newline normalization before table rendering.
evidence: product.diff: fieldValueDisplay covers date, iteration, labels, number, select, text, milestone, PR, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff: projectFieldValue returns an empty string when no value has the requested field ID

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers are appended in request order; each item adds one cell per selected field by field node ID, preserving alignment and empty missing cells.
evidence: product.diff: printResults appends field.Name() headers and adds one projectFieldValue per selected field
product.diff: projectFieldValue compares value.ID() with the selected field ID
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/item-list/item_list.go: unchanged owner/project/item command path remains reachable

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Project and field-resolution errors return before table output. The focused diff reuses established query types and table rendering, with passing supplied focused tests.
evidence: product.diff: runList returns errors from ProjectItems and selectedFields before printResults
product.diff: uses queries.ProjectField and queries.FieldValueNodes rather than parallel data types
tests.log: focused item-list and shared-query package tests exited 0

criticalGaps: --field and --field-id are not mutually exclusive, and field selections are silently ignored by formatted/JSON export.
Field definitions are limited to the first query page; selected fields on later pages cannot resolve.
Multiline value normalization is not established by the supplied candidate context.
Ambiguous field-ID candidates are not explicitly sorted.
